event.name: CRIT SDP-REC Program Bounce House Event

profile.description: Colorado River Indian Tribes Recreation / SDP-REC relationship. Robin Howard made an inbound pricing inquiry June 4, 2026. A Gmail audit on Aug. 29 found no later Adventure Zone response, so this is an unanswered inbound buying inquiry rather than cold outreach.

notes.subject: Aug. 29 Gmail audit — pricing inquiry was unanswered
notes.body: Robin Howard asked June 4 for prices, setup/breakdown charges and any other invoice costs. Gmail search through Aug. 29 found no later reply from Adventure Zone. A reply draft was prepared in the existing Gmail thread with current package pricing ($9,000 Adventure Zone; $7,500 Pirate's Rebellion; $7,500 Warrior's Playground, 1-4 days), clarification that normal setup/tear-down/staffing/COI are included, and a request for event date, site and operating hours before availability/logistics are confirmed.

followUps.label: CRIT — review/send pricing reply draft
followUps.reason: A current reply draft now exists in Robin Howard's original Gmail thread. Review/send it, then obtain the event date/site/hours and move the opportunity into availability/logistics review.
